description: Na₃CaCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.67 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.95 Å. Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.78 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-58°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom.
